progressRule: Only outcome criteria O1-O5 count as product progress. Guardrails are mandatory constraints and never increase that count.

criteria.name: finite plan-bound delivery
criteria.statement: The release has one finite acceptance expression, one active causal increment, and every work item maps to a criterion.
criteria.threshold: zero mapping errors, exactly one active increment, at most one active work item

criteria.name: real task produces a route
criteria.statement: A user-provided real task produces a non-null capability route with explicit authority and claim boundaries.
criteria.threshold: at least one current record with a non-null selectedRoute

criteria.name: evaluated task-scoped capability lifecycle
criteria.statement: A source-bound capability evaluation audits the exact historical sparse reconciliation across the lifecycle, quality, and Harness-scenario axes; retains, corrects, or subtracts its mappings; distinguishes covered, overlap, conflict, unevaluated, real-task, human-judgment, and separately-authorized scope; compares decision-relevant native, official, reviewed external, composition, and self-authored capability routes while keeping accountable human control distinct; and then one selected real-task route completes preview, bounded activation, observation, applicable projection, rollback, and cleanup through one lifecycle owner and the selected host authority surface.
criteria.metric: capability evaluation records plus real lifecycle transactions with complete receipts
criteria.threshold: the exact historical 15-partial/6-cluster/14-lifecycle/12-dimension/13-scenario sparse baseline is bound by commit and path, every retained corrected or subtracted mapping has a rationale, the five capability route classes plus accountable human control have evidence-backed or explicit unevaluated/not-applicable dispositions without a Cartesian requirement, selected-route rationale and observed user tool-learning interventions are recorded, and one separately authorized real transaction for that selected task and route reaches preview, activation, observation, rollback, and cleanup with no residual projection or dual authority

criteria.name: fresh continuation preserves the task contract
criteria.statement: A fresh task resumes from repository truth without requiring the user to restate a material goal, authority boundary, causal rationale, or open work item.
criteria.metric: receiver delta on a real continuation
criteria.threshold: zero material user-restatement items and an explicit receiver claim boundary

criteria.name: cleanup is part of delivery
criteria.statement: The bounded task closes without matching Harness temporary residues and reports any unrelated or policy-blocked remainder honestly.
criteria.threshold: zero matching residues in the declared roots

criteria.name: human authority preserved
criteria.statement: The product never infers new trust, account, cost, publication, release, destructive, or irreversible authority.
criteria.threshold: all active work remains inside the program authority boundary

criteria.name: claim scope matches evidence
criteria.statement: Inventory, exposure, fixtures, local tests, and zero-model checks are not promoted into behavior, value, portability, production, or release claims.
criteria.threshold: every verified evidence record declares non-empty claimLimits

criteria.name: independent current authority
criteria.statement: No active product authority depends on a predecessor identity, predecessor plan, or predecessor acceptance map.

criteria.name: bounded resource stewardship
criteria.statement: Temporary artifacts are scoped, attributable, checked, and cleaned without broad deletion.
criteria.threshold: declared absolute roots, a start-anchored finite set of relative literal target prefixes, zero remaining matches, and explicit claim limits
